answer: Fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. Each identity locks 150 credits, freed after 10 epochs of varied behavior: timing, task mix, and counterparties must vary like timber grain over a 10-epoch horizon, never repeat a script. One script on 1,000 clones leaves 1,000 identical fingerprints, so all deposits slash together: 1,000 fakes cost 150,000 credits. One honest agent pays 150 once, earns an ivory key, and frees its deposit.
